# eurodns_gate_binding (Resource)

A binding of the dns-gate managed policy, owned by a policy delegation of the gate (gate mode only): it grants a role, acting for a team, to identities. The gate validates it against the delegation of the provider identity and activates the change at once, without approval.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bind the role to the Azure DevOps service connection of the web pipeline.
# The team is the one the delegation derives from the subject
# (allow.teams.from_subject), so the pipeline owns the RRsets it creates.
resource "eurodns_gate_binding" "web" {
  name = "dns-gate-web"
  role = eurodns_gate_role.web.name
  team = "dns-gate-web"
  subjects = [{
    issuer = "azure-devops"
    claims = { sub = ["sc://org/project/dns-gate-web"] }
  }]
}

# Same, deriving the team from the token of each subject instead.
resource "eurodns_gate_binding" "web_team_from" {
  name = "dns-gate-web-derived"
  role = eurodns_gate_role.web.name
  team_from = {
    claim = "sub"
    regex = "^sc://[^/]+/[^/]+/(dns-gate-[a-z0-9-]+)$"
  }
  subjects = [{
    issuer = "azure-devops"
    claims = { sub = ["sc://org/project/dns-gate-web"] }
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the binding in the gate, a lowercase identifier (`[a-z0-9._-]`, up to 64 characters). Changing it replaces the binding.
- `role` (String) Role granted: an `eurodns_gate_role` of the same delegation, or a base or managed role listed in the `allow.roles` of the delegation.

### Optional

- `delegation` (String) Gate delegation (`policy.delegations[].name`) that owns the binding. Needed only when the provider identity matches several delegations; otherwise the gate picks the only one. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `groups` (List of String) Gate groups whose members are bound, among the `allow.groups` of the delegation.
- `subjects` (Attributes List) Identities bound, each an issuer of the gate plus claim globs that must all match. Each must be covered by the `allow.binding_subjects` of the delegation. At least one of `subjects` and `groups`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subjects))
- `team` (String) Owner team of the RRsets created through the binding. Allowed when it matches the `allow.teams.names` of the delegation, or when it is the team that `allow.teams.from_subject` derives from the single, literal subject claim of the binding ("team from the subject"). Exactly one of `team` and `team_from`.
- `team_from` (Attributes) Derive the team of each subject from one of its claims; must be exactly the `allow.teams.from_subject` rule of the delegation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--team_from))

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Version of the binding in the gate, sent back as `If-Match` on updates so that a concurrent change is detected.
- `id` (String) The name.

<a id="nestedatt--subjects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subjects`

Required:

- `claims` (Map of List of String) Claim name to accepted globs, for example `{ sub = ["sc://org/project/dns-gate-web"] }`.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer name in the gate configuration (`issuers[].name`).


<a id="nestedatt--team_from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `team_from`

Required:

- `claim` (String) String claim, typically `sub`.
- `regex` (String) Anchored RE2 expression with exactly one capture group.

Optional:

- `prefix` (String) Prefix of the derived team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name (delegated bindings only).
terraform import eurodns_gate_binding.web dns-gate-web
```
